title: InvenTrust Properties Corp. Acquires PGA Plaza in Palm Beach Gardens, FL
summary: InvenTrust Properties Corp. (InvenTrust or the Company) today announced the acquisition of PGA Plaza, a 120,000 square foot Trader Joes grocery-anchored neighborhood center located in Palm Beach Gardens, Florida, for $88 million from Delray Beach, FL based Menin Development Inc. This transaction represents a compelling growth opportunity for InvenTrust and expands the Companys presence in the vibrant and burgeoning South Florida market, said Michael E. Podboy, EVP Chief Financial Officer, Chief Investment Officer of InvenTrust. Following a $14 million renovation in 2015, PGA Plaza is a best-in-class property, attracting high traffic-driving anchors such as Trader Joes, Marshalls and Ulta.
